verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a populated llms.txt at api-dashboard.search.brave.com/llms.txt. Docs and API reference pages are served as markdown (index.html.md URLs), and Brave documents agent Skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and others, so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: the probed /app/documentation.md path returns 404 (markdown is not uniformly available at every docs URL), and there is no evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit guidance on consuming llms.txt.
